created.title: Ratify the new product IA, wireflows and redesign canon
created.description:
## Outcome

Replace the previous design direction with an explicit implementable architecture. Owner approval for radical UX/UI changes is already given; this task resolves implementation choices and records them, not requests the same approval again.

Audit traceability: OG-UX-001, OG-UX-002, OG-UX-005, OG-UX-006, OG-UX-007, OG-UX-009, OG-UX-042, OG-UX-043. Baseline audit: 2026-09-21, commit e554aec506e84ec6f8304c4704084671ed19f399. Recheck current main before editing; old observations may have changed.

## Owner decisions this task implements

The owner authorizes complete restructuring of layout, pages and functional groups. Threads leads style, [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) supplies centered layout and applicable content interactions, Airbnb informs progressive setup. Phosphor is the only UI icon family; Thiings supports illustrations with unrestricted owner-directed selection and no paid purchase/license-review gate. Fast writing to any of many owned spaces/objects takes precedence over decorative dashboards.

Task-specific references: [Full reference and decision register](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/redesign-execution-contract-owner-decisions-references-and-proof-f8007f2ae99c>).

Read the [execution contract](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/redesign-execution-contract-owner-decisions-references-and-proof-f8007f2ae99c>) and [audit findings](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/audit-evidence-45-og-ux-findings-2026-09-21-9137eb58e042>); creation-related work also follows [fast writing](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/fast-writing-spaces-objects-destination-picker-and-recovery-4a839349a952>). References are inspected patterns, not proven conversion claims.

## Scope (in / out)

In: deliver the outcome and numbered criteria below, including integration, copy, responsive states and proof for these surfaces. Replace obsolete layout assertions when the ratified canon changes. Out: implementing sibling outcomes merely because they share components, duplicating external technical/editorial tasks, or silently changing journal persistence, media, canonical-address, privacy or authorization contracts. This issue is executable; the parent is coordination only.

## Key files

* `DESIGN.md`
* `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`
* `docs/adr/ADR-0031-design-system-and-redesign.md`
* `docs/adr/ADR-0028-notion-shaped-composer.md`
* `docs/audits/2026-09-21-product-design/`
* `docs/redesign/2026-09-21/EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md` and relevant current ADRs.

Paths are baseline entry points, not an exhaustive change whitelist. Resolve moved files on current main; explicitly document newly introduced routes/components and their callers. Do not recreate retired paths based on this list.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Commit the audit package and this execution plan so a fresh checkout contains the actual findings, screenshots and manifest; verify no personal tokens or private data are added.
2. Create an old-to-new route/function matrix for every family in ROUTES.md: primary user job, audience, primary action, secondary information, destination and responsible issue. Existing public permalinks remain canonical.
3. Define Home/feed, Explore, My garden, Activity and account utilities as distinct jobs. Split timelines from settings and provenance. Record desktop/mobile nav labels and active-route rules; do not expose owner controls to ordinary members.
4. Produce linked low-fidelity wireflows for same-name object selection, a space observation, first object, changing destination mid-composition, community writing and failed publish. Use at least 3 spaces and 100 objects, including unassigned objects.
5. Amend the old Linear/Notion/GitHub visual priority to Threads, centered [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) shell plus applicable social patterns, Airbnb progressive setup, Phosphor-only interface icons and Thiings illustration direction. Resolve fixed composer width/gutter without deleting supported blocks.
6. Define measurable action budgets: contextual open 1 activation; global recent destination open+select 2; Publish explicit and separately counted. Search typing and media picking reported separately. Pick one transaction model for new destination+first entry and state what persists if publication fails.
7. Create a transition plan that keeps each intermediate merged page usable. Research with recruited gardeners is desirable but not falsely claimed; executable fixture walkthroughs are required now.

## Proof

Attach IA map, route ownership table, wireflows and canon diff. Run the design/posture checks affected by documentation. Distinguish hypothesis, observed audit fact and owner decision; link each flow to acceptance scenarios.

Attach changed-file/behavior summary, exact tested SHA and relevant automated output. Use ordinary member as well as owner where roles apply; verify UK/BG/RU, narrow/wide layouts, empty/populated and pending/error/retry states. Public changes require canonical/static/no-JS proof; workspace changes require hard-load bounded failure proof. Mutations require actual server outcome. Register browser tests in the real gate. Manual accessibility evidence cannot be replaced by an axe score. Follow repository PR/CI/release closeout; local success alone is not production proof. Never publish test content to production without the applicable authorization.

## Dependencies

* No implementation predecessor; start from current main and the attached audit.
* Parent <issue id="111537a9-9947-4fda-a9b0-ec93899fbb44" href="https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-474/complete-product-redesign-audit-implementation-and-release">OVE-474</issue> is coordination only and does not block this child.
* Follow native Linear blockers, not numerical order alone. Coordinate shared-file edits; preserve existing <issue id="faf54cbd-0537-46eb-b6e7-6eb89052ba84" href="https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-467/the-remaining-public-families-become-static-documents-adr-0032-d8">OVE-467</issue>/468/469 and editorial issue scopes.

created.title: Build the Threads design system with Phosphor-only interface icons
created.description:
## Outcome

Create one quiet light visual language that all surfaces consume, with typography and hierarchy driven by reading and writing rather than decorative cards. Use Phosphor as the single UI icon source throughout public, signed-in and owner surfaces, including editor controls.

Audit traceability: OG-UX-005, OG-UX-014, OG-UX-031, OG-UX-041, OG-UX-042. Baseline: 2026-09-21, e554aec506e84ec6f8304c4704084671ed19f399. Recheck current main before editing.

## Owner decisions this task implements

Radical layout/IA/page regrouping is authorized. Threads leads the light visual system; [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) provides the centered three-column group and relevant reading/social patterns; Airbnb informs progressive setup. Phosphor is the sole UI icon library. Thiings selection/use is unrestricted by owner direction, with no purchase or license-review gate; provider facts are recorded honestly in the contract. The central goal is quick acknowledged writing to any owned space/object, including large collections.

References: [Threads focused composer](<https://mobbin.com/flows/b38612ad-da22-4755-a575-084a64ec4cc0>); [Threads light visual grammar](<https://mobbin.com/screens/0db0ea31-1837-4a35-98c8-dbb2d460b0e1>). Read the [execution contract](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/redesign-execution-contract-owner-decisions-references-and-proof-f8007f2ae99c>), [45-finding audit](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/audit-evidence-45-og-ux-findings-2026-09-21-9137eb58e042>) and [fast writing specification](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/fast-writing-spaces-objects-destination-picker-and-recovery-4a839349a952>).

## Scope (in / out)

In: all numbered criteria and their integration/proof, including responsive, role, locale and failure states. This issue intentionally consolidates related original work packages 04 after the owner chose 32 executable issues to fit Linear's workspace limit; none of those acceptance requirements is deferred. Out: unrelated backend/persistence/security changes, duplicate static/performance/editorial implementations or unapproved destructive production operations. Public static bytes, canonical addresses, server authorization, settled workspace reads, Lexical/JournalDocumentV1 and browser WebP publishing remain authoritative. No durable gardener drafts; owner editorial drafts remain a separate allowed contract.

## Key files

* `DESIGN.md`
* `apps/web/src/components/ui/`
* `apps/web/src/app/`
* `apps/web/src/components/`
* `apps/web/package.json`
* `docs/redesign/2026-09-21/EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md`, current `AGENTS.md` and relevant ADRs.

These are baseline entry points, not a file whitelist. Resolve moved paths and explicitly document new routes/components. Do not restore retired surfaces merely because an old path appears here.

## Acceptance criteria

 1. Define primitive and semantic color, spacing, typography, radius, border, elevation and motion tokens. Keep existing fonts unless the canon explicitly changes them; do not introduce another visual theme for owner screens.
 2. Build or adapt button, icon button, input, field error, select, tabs, menu, dialog, sheet, toast/status, skeleton and empty-state primitives with default/hover/focus/pressed/disabled/pending/error states.
 3. Default to restrained surfaces, author-first text hierarchy and consistent separators. Give content photos their own sizing policy; no universal oversized 4:3 cover.
 4. Meet text contrast 4.5:1 normal/3:1 large and meaningful non-text contrast 3:1; focus stays visible and unobscured. Controls meet WCAG 2.2 target sizing or documented exceptions; aim 44px for primary touch actions.
 5. Respect reduced motion, text zoom and forced colors. Decorative motion never communicates the only state.
 6. Update mechanical design gates to enforce the new canon without treating passing token checks as proof of usability. Publish a component specimen route or existing equivalent for visual verification.
 7. Inventory Lucide, Radix icon assets, react-icons, bespoke functional SVGs and emoji used as controls; map every semantic action to one Phosphor glyph. Keep brand marks, favicons and user media as explicit non-interface-icon exceptions.
 8. Create a small typed icon entry point with consistent weight and size tokens; selected states may use a documented fill variation of the same family, never a second family.
 9. Use server-compatible imports for static/server components and narrow imports so the full icon collection is not bundled into guest chrome. Verify package API against its installed official docs.
10. Provide accessible names on icon-only controls; decorative icons are hidden from AT. Tooltips supplement labels, not replace them. Meaning cannot depend solely on glyph or color.
11. Remove unused old icon dependencies after all consumers migrate; prevent reintroduction through an appropriate import/source gate.
12. Inspect desktop/mobile navigation, dialogs, rich editor, social actions, validation, owner tables and loading states. Thiings art is illustration, not a substitute icon family.

## Proof

Capture actual component states at narrow/wide sizes; measure color pairs, test keyboard focus and dialog return. Run relevant component/design gates. No screenshots of only default states.

Provide inventory before/after and justified brand exceptions; run source gate, build/typecheck and bundle comparison. Visually verify representative controls at 16/20/24px and keyboard accessible names.

Attach exact tested SHA, behavior/file summary, screenshots and relevant gate output. Verify applicable guest/member/owner roles, UK/BG/RU long labels, narrow/wide layouts, keyboard, zoom, empty/populated and pending/error/retry states. Public changes require canonical/static/no-JS proof; workspace changes require hard-load failure proof. Mutations require acknowledged server outcomes. Register browser specs in the actual gate; automated accessibility checks do not replace manual evidence. Follow repository PR/CI/release rules, distinguishing local results from production; production test mutations require applicable authorization.

## Dependencies

* Blocked by <issue id="7dc3985a-9da0-4e8a-bebe-6c6428c9edf8" href="https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-475/ratify-the-new-product-ia-wireflows-and-redesign-canon">OVE-475</issue>.
* <issue id="111537a9-9947-4fda-a9b0-ec93899fbb44" href="https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-474/complete-product-redesign-audit-implementation-and-release">OVE-474</issue> is coordination only, not a blocker. Native relations define order; issue numbering does not.
* Preserve <issue id="faf54cbd-0537-46eb-b6e7-6eb89052ba84" href="https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-467/the-remaining-public-families-become-static-documents-adr-0032-d8">OVE-467</issue>/468/469 technical ownership and planned editorial work. Coordinate shared files and never close on missing proof.

## Acceptance criteria

 1. Run the route/function ownership matrix for all audit page families and new routes; classify each as migrated, intentionally redirected, retired by existing contract or explicitly future capability. No unowned family remains.
 2. Review UK/BG/RU product terminology: space, object, organism, entry and journal each retain one meaning. Long translations never overlap controls; UGC language does not leak into localized chrome.
 3. Check 404, seven-day 410, forbidden, expired link, empty/new user, no search results, pending and bounded failure states. Offer one useful next action and preserve context where available.
 4. Apply Thiings only to appropriate benign setup/empty states and Phosphor to all functional controls, including owner and editor leftovers.
 5. Remove dead links, duplicate right-rail information and old settings/editor affordances from moved pages. Add internal-route redirects where needed without changing permanent public address law.
 6. Preserve static public bytes, settled workspace reads, late locale/session stability and essential no-JS links.
 7. Run guest, ordinary member and owner on UK/BG/RU and representative viewport/zoom sizes. Include keyboard-only plus at least one real screen-reader/browser pairing and record its version.
 8. Complete same-name object note, space weather note, change destination after text/media, create object while writing, failed publish recovery and find published entry. Count steps and verify actual acknowledged destination.
 9. Validate visible/unobscured focus, logical headings/landmarks, dialogue focus return, accessible names, status/errors, 24px target minimum/exceptions, dragging alternatives and accessible auth. Automated wcag22aa rules supplement manual proof.
10. Exercise mobile keyboard, portrait/landscape media, 200% text and 400% zoom/reflow. Capture contrast measurements and reduced-motion behavior.
11. No wrong-destination or duplicate entry is accepted in the controlled suite. Report fixture observations as such, not research with real gardeners or population statistics.
12. Map every OG-UX finding to receipt or explicit unresolved condition. Fix integration defects under this issue; do not close with a list of unowned blockers.
13. Confirm each prerequisite receipt and exact branch/main/deployment relationship. Historical Done redesign tasks do not satisfy new criteria automatically.
14. Re-run relevant full CI/browser/static-document gates on the integrated candidate, including realistic photo/network fixtures from <issue id="97fd4313-0a8f-44fc-9bf0-158d26ab5d66" href="https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-469/lcp-20-s-on-production-data-the-photograph-loses-the-network-race">OVE-469</issue> and guest bundle evidence from <issue id="d4eaed85-8276-44c6-923e-67c705b2de38" href="https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-468/a-guest-on-a-reading-page-downloads-337-kb-of-script-the-chromes">OVE-468</issue>.

16. Verify public canonical links, no-JS served content, authenticated owner/member journeys and consent behavior after release. Production mutations/deployment actions follow existing project authorization rules; radical UX permission is not bulk-delete/provider permission.
17. Produce finding-by-finding closure ledger and full route-family coverage, with residual issues linked and honestly classified. Update PROJECT_STATE and design canon to the actual shipped state.
18. Close implementation issues only on their required proof; close coordination parent only when required children and external blockers are verified complete. Do not claim improvements in retention/conversion without data.

created.title: Create the Thiings illustration system and integrate it into product states
created.description:
## Outcome

Use playful dimensional Thiings illustrations in the Airbnb-like product moments while keeping the Threads reading surfaces calm.

Audit traceability: Explicit owner requirement; not an invented audit defect.. Baseline: 2026-09-21, e554aec506e84ec6f8304c4704084671ed19f399. Recheck current main before editing.

## Owner decisions this task implements

Radical layout/IA/page regrouping is authorized. Threads leads the light visual system; [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) provides the centered three-column group and relevant reading/social patterns; Airbnb informs progressive setup. Phosphor is the sole UI icon library. Thiings selection/use is unrestricted by owner direction, with no purchase or license-review gate; provider facts are recorded honestly in the contract. The central goal is quick acknowledged writing to any owned space/object, including large collections.

References: [Thiings collection](<https://www.thiings.co/things>); [Airbnb progressive context](<https://mobbin.com/flows/4e9f5861-5367-4700-883b-248771553904>). Read the [execution contract](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/redesign-execution-contract-owner-decisions-references-and-proof-f8007f2ae99c>), [45-finding audit](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/audit-evidence-45-og-ux-findings-2026-09-21-9137eb58e042>) and [fast writing specification](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/fast-writing-spaces-objects-destination-picker-and-recovery-4a839349a952>).

## Scope (in / out)

In: all numbered criteria and their integration/proof, including responsive, role, locale and failure states.  Out: unrelated backend/persistence/security changes, duplicate static/performance/editorial implementations or unapproved destructive production operations. Public static bytes, canonical addresses, server authorization, settled workspace reads, Lexical/JournalDocumentV1 and browser WebP publishing remain authoritative. No durable gardener drafts; owner editorial drafts remain a separate allowed contract.

## Key files

* `DESIGN.md`
* `apps/web/public/`
* `apps/web/src/components/ui/`
* `docs/redesign/2026-09-21/`
* `docs/redesign/2026-09-21/EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md`, current `AGENTS.md` and relevant ADRs.

These are baseline entry points, not a file whitelist. Resolve moved paths and explicitly document new routes/components. Do not restore retired surfaces merely because an old path appears here.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Owner direction: use illustrations from [https://www.thiings.co/things](<https://www.thiings.co/things>) with unrestricted selection across the collection and free use; do not introduce a paid subscription, purchase, restricted shortlist or licensing review as a start/completion gate. The factual provider-terms discrepancy is recorded in the execution contract and is not this task blocker.
2. Create an asset manifest with source item URL, download date, local filename, dimensions, checksum, role and any required source attribution. Do not fabricate a commercial-license receipt or hide the source; the user instruction is a product decision, not provider-issued licensing evidence.
3. Select a coherent set for first garden, space setup, object setup, no entries, no results and successful setup. Avoid making every screen decorative or using cheerful art for destructive/error consequences.
4. Define consistent scale, optical padding, background, cropping and maximum placement sizes. Use genuine user photos for living objects; illustration must never look like evidence of a real organism or claim a species match.
5. Deliver responsive locally served optimized assets with explicit dimensions and suitable empty alt for decorative art. No third-party hotlink dependency or critical above-fold heavy download. Never bypass payment/access controls or redistribute an asset collection.
6. Wire the shared illustration component into applicable creation and empty-state templates; subsequent surface issues choose semantic asset IDs rather than arbitrary image URLs.

## Proof

Attach the asset/contact sheet and source manifest, rendered light-theme examples, byte/dimension checks and disabled-image/AT review. No licensing review gate or paid purchase; no invented commercial clearance.

Attach exact tested SHA, behavior/file summary, screenshots and relevant gate output. Verify applicable guest/member/owner roles, UK/BG/RU long labels, narrow/wide layouts, keyboard, zoom, empty/populated and pending/error/retry states. Public changes require canonical/static/no-JS proof; workspace changes require hard-load failure proof. Mutations require acknowledged server outcomes. Register browser specs in the actual gate; automated accessibility checks do not replace manual evidence. Follow repository PR/CI/release rules, distinguishing local results from production; production test mutations require applicable authorization.

## Dependencies

* Blocked by <issue id="c3c1ccda-a42e-474e-b71f-03436b1d403d" href="https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-477/build-the-threads-visual-foundations-and-accessible-component-states">OVE-477</issue>.

* Preserve <issue id="faf54cbd-0537-46eb-b6e7-6eb89052ba84" href="https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-467/the-remaining-public-families-become-static-documents-adr-0032-d8">OVE-467</issue>/468/469 technical ownership and planned editorial work. created.description:

The owner authorizes complete restructuring of layout, pages and functional groups. Threads leads style, [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) supplies centered layout and applicable content interactions, Airbnb informs progressive setup. Phosphor is the only UI icon family; Thiings supports illustrations with unrestricted owner-directed selection and no paid purchase/license-review gate. Fast writing to any of many owned spaces/objects takes precedence over decorative dashboards.

Task-specific references: [Full reference and decision register](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/redesign-execution-contract-owner-decisions-references-and-proof-f8007f2ae99c>).

References are inspected patterns, not proven conversion claims.

## Scope (in / out)

In: deliver the outcome and numbered criteria below, including integration, copy, responsive states and proof for these surfaces. Replace obsolete layout assertions when the ratified canon changes. Out: implementing sibling outcomes merely because they share components, duplicating external technical/editorial tasks, or silently changing journal persistence, media, canonical-address, privacy or authorization contracts. This issue is executable; the parent is coordination only.

## Key files

* `apps/web/tests/`
* `apps/web/scripts/browser-gate-specs.ts`
* `apps/web/scripts/run-browser-gate.ts`
* `docs/audits/2026-09-21-product-design/ACCESSIBILITY.md`

2. Create text-only, portrait/landscape/multiple photo, mixed-script, long entry, deleted destination, empty list, failing section and realistic media-weight fixtures. Keep real production personal content out of fixtures.
3. Configure automated coverage for relevant WCAG 2.2 AA rules including wcag22aa where supported, and record tool/rule versions. Automated pass is not conformance certification.
4. Provide reusable keyboard, focus return, live status and pending/error assertions; include 320px, 390px, 768px, 1280px and 1920px plus 200% text/400% zoom checks where relevant.
5. Register every new browser spec in the actual browser gate. Document screen-reader/manual steps and which cannot be automated; no dormant spec outside CI.
6. Retain baseline reproductions for wrong global CTA, first-space selection and filter Close being named Reset all.

## Proof

Run the fixture setup and representative gate from a clean checkout, attach command outputs and coverage matrix. Prove at least one baseline regression test fails before its corresponding UI correction.

Attach changed-file/behavior summary, exact tested SHA and relevant automated output. Use ordinary member as well as owner where roles apply; verify UK/BG/RU, narrow/wide layouts, empty/populated and pending/error/retry states. Public changes require canonical/static/no-JS proof; workspace changes require hard-load bounded failure proof. Mutations require actual server outcome. Register browser tests in the real gate. Manual accessibility evidence cannot be replaced by an axe score. Follow repository PR/CI/release closeout; local success alone is not production proof. Never publish test content to production without the applicable authorization.

## Outcome

Public static bytes, canonical addresses, server authorization, settled workspace reads, Lexical/JournalDocumentV1 and browser WebP publishing remain authoritative. * `apps/web/src/components/living-object-passport/living-object-passport.tsx`

## Acceptance criteria

 3. Breadcrumbs reflect owner/object relationship rather than pretending the owned object is a catalogue species. Owner Write leads to exact owned destination.
 4. Read-only guests never see executable owner mutations; claim/invitation UI uses existing server identity and authorization semantics.
 5. Render uncertain lineage as uncertain, with source/relationship details; do not imply a verified genetic or ownership fact from an unreviewed claim.
 6. Preserve permanent ASCII addresses, alias behavior, static public document and deleted-object semantics.
 7. Separate questions requiring an answer, pending claims and invitation acceptance. Show source/target object, gardener and current status using real identity, not technical IDs alone.
 8. Before accepting/rejecting/reassigning, state what relationship changes and what stays owned/public according to the backend. Do not equate a claimed relation with verified biology.

10. Keep return intent through authentication without exposing token values in UI/analytics. No secret-bearing screenshots in receipts.
11. Use deliberate secondary placement from object provenance; no lineage actions compete with routine New entry.
12. Support long labels, related objects with same names, safe cancel, failed action and keyboard focus return.

created.title: Redesign communities, discussions and moderation operations
created.description:
## Outcome

A community is a coherent context for reading and contributing; its first-post action no longer drops users into an unrelated garden setup. Owner moderation and community management are clear task-oriented extensions of the same design system.

Audit traceability: OG-UX-017, OG-UX-035, OG-UX-040. Baseline: 2026-09-21, e554aec506e84ec6f8304c4704084671ed19f399. Recheck current main before editing.

Threads leads the light visual system; [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) provides the centered three-column group and relevant reading/social patterns; Airbnb informs progressive setup. Phosphor is the sole UI icon library. Thiings selection/use is unrestricted by owner direction, with no purchase or license-review gate; provider facts are recorded honestly in the contract. The central goal is quick acknowledged writing to any owned space/object, including large collections.

References: [vc.ru](<https://vc.ru/>) (live audit screenshots 08/16 and documented feed observations); [Threads post hierarchy](<https://mobbin.com/screens/b05902e9-b215-47d3-afb7-54346c11af0d>). ## Scope (in / out)

In: all numbered criteria and their integration/proof, including responsive, role, locale and failure states. This issue intentionally consolidates related original work packages 33 after the owner chose 32 executable issues to fit Linear's workspace limit; none of those acceptance requirements is deferred. Out: unrelated backend/persistence/security changes, duplicate static/performance/editorial implementations or unapproved destructive production operations. Public static bytes, canonical addresses, server authorization, settled workspace reads, Lexical/JournalDocumentV1 and browser WebP publishing remain authoritative. No durable gardener drafts; owner editorial drafts remain a separate allowed contract.

## Key files

* `apps/web/src/components/public/public-community.tsx`
* `apps/web/src/app/[locale]/communities/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/account/communities/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/account/moderation/comments/`
* `docs/redesign/2026-09-21/EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md`, current `AGENTS.md` and relevant ADRs.

These are baseline entry points, not a file whitelist. Resolve moved paths and explicitly document new routes/components. Do not restore retired surfaces merely because an old path appears here.

## Acceptance criteria

 1. Directory cards and detail header explain topic, community identity and actual supported membership/contribution actions. Use [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) topic attribution/navigation mechanism while retaining Threads styling.
 2. Community Write carries exact community context through sign-in and supported contribution composer; do not silently turn a discussion into an owned-object entry. If entries can be shared, preserve one original identity and existing association rules.
 3. Show current discussion list, author/date, relevant community information and clear empty-first-contribution state. Right rail supports this community rather than generic welcome content.
 4. Discussion detail reuses readable post/comment controls while respecting its own entity and canonical URL. No unsupported ranking or moderation capability invented.
 5. Move community management to appropriate owner/account context with role checks and purposeful settings; no admin panel recreation.
 6. Verify back navigation, guest entry points, deleted discussions, forbidden contribution and partial errors.
 7. Show content context, author, reason/state and actual available action before changing moderation state; avoid unlabeled icon-only destructive actions.
 8. Separate queue filtering, item review and community settings into meaningful sections. Preserve exact comment/discussion/community identity when moving between them.
 9. Confirm destructive consequences where required, keep cancel and retry safe, prevent double submission and reconcile actual server result.
10. Guest/ordinary member cannot read protected content or perform owner mutations even when copying a URL or submitting a forged form.
11. Provide empty queue, loading, failed row and failed list states; preserve filter/scroll on action and do not hide unrelated rows after one error.
12. Use Phosphor, semantic tables/lists, accessible menus and responsive controls; reuse community public context without exposing private moderation metadata.

## Proof

Guest→sign-in→same community intent, member post in seeded environment, comments and directory/detail/back across locales. Assert submitted community ID and absence of accidental garden-object creation.

Controlled owner review, failed action, duplicate submit and ordinary-member forged request tests; keyboard and mobile populated queues with exact server-state readback.

Public changes require canonical/static/no-JS proof; workspace changes require hard-load failure proof. Mutations require acknowledged server outcomes. Audit traceability: OG-UX-001, OG-UX-035. Baseline audit: 2026-09-21, commit e554aec506e84ec6f8304c4704084671ed19f399. Recheck current main before editing; old observations may have changed.

## Owner decisions this task implements

The owner authorizes complete restructuring of layout, pages and functional groups. Threads leads style, [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) supplies centered layout and applicable content interactions, Airbnb informs progressive setup. Phosphor is the only UI icon family; Thiings supports illustrations with unrestricted owner-directed selection and no paid purchase/license-review gate. Fast writing to any of many owned spaces/objects takes precedence over decorative dashboards.

Task-specific references: [Airbnb web progressive search](<https://mobbin.com/flows/4e9f5861-5367-4700-883b-248771553904>); [Airbnb mobile progressive search](<https://mobbin.com/flows/0fb29365-f327-46b6-9a6d-2dfbb5589716>).

Read the [execution contract](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/redesign-execution-contract-owner-decisions-references-and-proof-f8007f2ae99c>) and [audit findings](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/audit-evidence-45-og-ux-findings-2026-09-21-9137eb58e042>); creation-related work also follows [fast writing](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/fast-writing-spaces-objects-destination-picker-and-recovery-4a839349a952>). References are inspected patterns, not proven conversion claims.

## Scope (in / out)

In: deliver the outcome and numbered criteria below, including integration, copy, responsive states and proof for these surfaces. Replace obsolete layout assertions when the ratified canon changes. Out: implementing sibling outcomes merely because they share components, duplicating external technical/editorial tasks, or silently changing journal persistence, media, canonical-address, privacy or authorization contracts. This issue is executable; the parent is coordination only.

## Key files

* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/auth/`
* `apps/web/src/server/workspace-access.ts`
* `docs/redesign/2026-09-21/EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md` and relevant current ADRs.

Paths are baseline entry points, not an exhaustive change whitelist. Resolve moved files on current main; explicitly document newly introduced routes/components and their callers. Do not recreate retired paths based on this list.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Use consistent focused layouts for sign-in, sign-up, reset-password and auth help, with clear mode changes and inline recoverable errors.
2. Preserve validated same-origin return intent for writing, commenting, saving and community contribution. Reject open redirects and unauthorized object IDs server-side.
3. Allow password-manager/autofill/paste; accessible authentication never requires memorization puzzles introduced by the redesign.
4. Explain when a full-page transition cannot preserve transient writing; use in-memory recovery only where viable and no IndexedDB/local draft workaround.
5. Expired links, already authenticated users, provider/network failure and pending submissions have distinct states. Existing security and anti-enumeration behavior stays intact.
6. Locale choice persists according to shipped ADR-0029/current language contract rather than flipping when a canonical unprefixed link opens.

## Proof

Guest action→auth→target for object/space/community/bookmark, invalid return URL, expired reset and keyboard/autofill scenarios; verify no unauthorized destination and no durable browser journal data.

Attach changed-file/behavior summary, exact tested SHA and relevant automated output. Use ordinary member as well as owner where roles apply; verify UK/BG/RU, narrow/wide layouts, empty/populated and pending/error/retry states. Public changes require canonical/static/no-JS proof; workspace changes require hard-load bounded failure proof. Mutations require actual server outcome. Register browser tests in the real gate. Manual accessibility evidence cannot be replaced by an axe score. Follow repository PR/CI/release closeout; local success alone is not production proof. Never publish test content to production without the applicable authorization.

created.title: Redesign consent, privacy and member/owner erasure workflows
created.description:
## Outcome

Trust surfaces communicate real choices and consequences while keeping public reading accessible. The owner can understand and process erasure requests with accurate consequences and clear state while existing deletion policy remains authoritative.

Audit traceability: OG-UX-004, OG-UX-037, OG-UX-044. Baseline: 2026-09-21, e554aec506e84ec6f8304c4704084671ed19f399. Recheck current main before editing.

## Owner decisions this task implements

Radical layout/IA/page regrouping is authorized. Threads leads the light visual system; [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) provides the centered three-column group and relevant reading/social patterns; Airbnb informs progressive setup. Phosphor is the sole UI icon library. Thiings selection/use is unrestricted by owner direction, with no purchase or license-review gate; provider facts are recorded honestly in the contract. The central goal is quick acknowledged writing to any owned space/object, including large collections.

References: [Airbnb web progressive search](<https://mobbin.com/flows/4e9f5861-5367-4700-883b-248771553904>); [Airbnb mobile progressive search](<https://mobbin.com/flows/0fb29365-f327-46b6-9a6d-2dfbb5589716>). Read the [execution contract](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/redesign-execution-contract-owner-decisions-references-and-proof-f8007f2ae99c>), [45-finding audit](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/audit-evidence-45-og-ux-findings-2026-09-21-9137eb58e042>) and [fast writing specification](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/fast-writing-spaces-objects-destination-picker-and-recovery-4a839349a952>).

## Scope (in / out)

In: all numbered criteria and their integration/proof, including responsive, role, locale and failure states. This issue intentionally consolidates related original work packages 35 after the owner chose 32 executable issues to fit Linear's workspace limit; none of those acceptance requirements is deferred. Out: unrelated backend/persistence/security changes, duplicate static/performance/editorial implementations or unapproved destructive production operations. Public static bytes, canonical addresses, server authorization, settled workspace reads, Lexical/JournalDocumentV1 and browser WebP publishing remain authoritative. No durable gardener drafts; owner editorial drafts remain a separate allowed contract.

## Key files

* `apps/web/src/lib/privacy/`
* `apps/web/src/app/[locale]/privacy/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/first-publication-disclosure/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/erasure/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/support/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/garden/privacy/erasure-requests/`
* `docs/redesign/2026-09-21/EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md`, current `AGENTS.md` and relevant ADRs.

These are baseline entry points, not a file whitelist. Resolve moved paths and explicitly document new routes/components. Do not restore retired surfaces merely because an old path appears here.

## Acceptance criteria

 1. Reduce consent obstruction using an accessible responsive placement. Preserve the existing requirement that undecided visitors see the notice on every page until a choice; no silent acceptance or hidden rejection.
 2. Choice controls remain equally understandable, keyboard reachable and usable at 320px/zoom. The overlay must not cover focused primary content indefinitely; test mobile safe areas.
 3. Privacy/disclosure/support follow reader-oriented typography and corrected factual content from task 02. Link to detailed explanations instead of showing database/queue jargon in the main flow.
 4. Erasure request describes scope, current retention and actual receipt/status; distinguish deleting an entry from erasing account-associated data and external cached copies.
 5. Keep token/verification failure, pending, accepted and completed states honest. Do not implement a destructive schema or bulk purge under UX authorization.
 6. Preserve consent-based analytics exclusions and first-publication acceptance logic.
 7. List requests with appropriate minimal identity, received date, verification state and next permissible action; keep sensitive details limited to needed role-protected views.
 8. Explain queue/processing/completed/failed state in plain language. Technical references may be available as secondary diagnostics rather than primary instructions.
 9. Destructive confirmation must describe actual scope; never implement bulk purge or destructive schema changes under redesign authorization.
10. Retry follows existing idempotent lifecycle and does not manufacture completion. Preserve audit receipts and retention behavior.
11. Cover empty/populated/error states, keyboard action flow, mobile tables and owner-role rejection for ordinary members.

## Proof

Undecided/accepted/rejected consent on multiple public routes, mobile zoom, keyboard and no-JS behavior; seeded erasure/support states and a content-to-contract reconciliation.

Seed lifecycle fixtures and demonstrate safe cancel/failed retry/read-only state transitions. Use approved controlled environment for mutation proof; report production approval requirements separately.

Attach exact tested SHA, behavior/file summary, screenshots and relevant gate output. Verify applicable guest/member/owner roles, UK/BG/RU long labels, narrow/wide layouts, keyboard, zoom, empty/populated and pending/error/retry states. Public changes require canonical/static/no-JS proof; workspace changes require hard-load failure proof. Mutations require acknowledged server outcomes. Register browser specs in the actual gate; automated accessibility checks do not replace manual evidence. Follow repository PR/CI/release rules, distinguishing local results from production; production test mutations require applicable authorization.
