readbacks.description:
## Outcome

Visitors distinguish an individual living object, its gardener, chronological evidence and its optional provenance from catalogue reference data. Lineage questions and claims are understandable relationship tasks with explicit participants and consequences.

Audit traceability: OG-UX-019, OG-UX-032, OG-UX-045. Baseline: 2026-09-21, e554aec506e84ec6f8304c4704084671ed19f399. Recheck current main before editing.

## Owner decisions this task implements

Radical layout/IA/page regrouping is authorized. Threads leads the light visual system; [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) provides the centered three-column group and relevant reading/social patterns; Airbnb informs progressive setup. Phosphor is the sole UI icon library. Thiings selection/use is unrestricted by owner direction, with no purchase or license-review gate; provider facts are recorded honestly in the contract. The central goal is quick acknowledged writing to any owned space/object, including large collections.

References: [vc.ru](<https://vc.ru/>) (live audit screenshots 08/16 and documented feed observations); [Threads post hierarchy](<https://mobbin.com/screens/b05902e9-b215-47d3-afb7-54346c11af0d>). Read the [execution contract](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/redesign-execution-contract-owner-decisions-references-and-proof-f8007f2ae99c>), [45-finding audit](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/audit-evidence-45-og-ux-findings-2026-09-21-9137eb58e042>) and [fast writing specification](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/fast-writing-spaces-objects-destination-picker-and-recovery-4a839349a952>).

## Scope (in / out)

In: all numbered criteria and their integration/proof, including responsive, role, locale and failure states. This issue intentionally consolidates related original work packages 34 after the owner chose 32 executable issues to fit Linear's workspace limit; none of those acceptance requirements is deferred. Out: unrelated backend/persistence/security changes, duplicate static/performance/editorial implementations or unapproved destructive production operations. Public static bytes, canonical addresses, server authorization, settled workspace reads, Lexical/JournalDocumentV1 and browser WebP publishing remain authoritative. No durable gardener drafts; owner editorial drafts remain a separate allowed contract.

## Key files

* `apps/web/src/components/living-object-passport/living-object-passport.tsx`
* `apps/web/src/app/[locale]/[profileHandle]/objects/[objectSlug]/`
* `apps/web/src/app/[locale]/lineage/objects/[objectId]/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/garden/lineage/claims/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/garden/lineage/questions/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/garden/lineage/invitations/claim/`
* `apps/web/src/lib/lineage/claim-handoff.ts`
* `docs/redesign/2026-09-21/EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md`, current `AGENTS.md` and relevant ADRs.

These are baseline entry points, not a file whitelist. Resolve moved paths and explicitly document new routes/components. Do not restore retired surfaces merely because an old path appears here.

## Acceptance criteria

 1. Lead with object name, owner and real photo when present; provide a meaningful link to canonical species/form as secondary reference.
 2. Use object-specific entry history and factual timeline. No empty technical provenance block above actual observations; progressively reveal relationships with clear labels.
 3. Breadcrumbs reflect owner/object relationship rather than pretending the owned object is a catalogue species. Owner Write leads to exact owned destination.
 4. Read-only guests never see executable owner mutations; claim/invitation UI uses existing server identity and authorization semantics.
 5. Render uncertain lineage as uncertain, with source/relationship details; do not imply a verified genetic or ownership fact from an unreviewed claim.
 6. Preserve permanent ASCII addresses, alias behavior, static public document and deleted-object semantics.
 7. Separate questions requiring an answer, pending claims and invitation acceptance. Show source/target object, gardener and current status using real identity, not technical IDs alone.
 8. Before accepting/rejecting/reassigning, state what relationship changes and what stays owned/public according to the backend. Do not equate a claimed relation with verified biology.
 9. Preserve signed invitation/token and server authorization contract; expired, already used, conflicting and unauthorized claims have distinct explanations.
10. Keep return intent through authentication without exposing token values in UI/analytics. No secret-bearing screenshots in receipts.
11. Use deliberate secondary placement from object provenance; no lineage actions compete with routine New entry.
12. Support long labels, related objects with same names, safe cancel, failed action and keyboard focus return.

## Proof

Compare guest and owner passport for unlinked and related objects; verify breadcrumbs, direct write context, static bytes and visible uncertainty using controlled lineage fixtures.

Fixture handoff for valid/expired/used invitation, cross-user misuse, duplicate names and failed acceptance; assert exact relationship outcome and no unsupported ownership change.

Attach exact tested SHA, behavior/file summary, screenshots and relevant gate output. Verify applicable guest/member/owner roles, UK/BG/RU long labels, narrow/wide layouts, keyboard, zoom, empty/populated and pending/error/retry states. Public changes require canonical/static/no-JS proof; workspace changes require hard-load failure proof. Mutations require acknowledged server outcomes. Register browser specs in the actual gate; automated accessibility checks do not replace manual evidence. Follow repository PR/CI/release rules, distinguishing local results from production; production test mutations require applicable authorization.

readbacks.title: Redesign communities, discussions and moderation operations
readbacks.description:
## Outcome

A community is a coherent context for reading and contributing; its first-post action no longer drops users into an unrelated garden setup. Owner moderation and community management are clear task-oriented extensions of the same design system.

Audit traceability: OG-UX-017, OG-UX-035, OG-UX-040. Baseline: 2026-09-21, e554aec506e84ec6f8304c4704084671ed19f399. Recheck current main before editing.

## Owner decisions this task implements

Radical layout/IA/page regrouping is authorized. Threads leads the light visual system; [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) provides the centered three-column group and relevant reading/social patterns; Airbnb informs progressive setup. Phosphor is the sole UI icon library. Thiings selection/use is unrestricted by owner direction, with no purchase or license-review gate; provider facts are recorded honestly in the contract. The central goal is quick acknowledged writing to any owned space/object, including large collections.

References: [vc.ru](<https://vc.ru/>) (live audit screenshots 08/16 and documented feed observations); [Threads post hierarchy](<https://mobbin.com/screens/b05902e9-b215-47d3-afb7-54346c11af0d>). Read the [execution contract](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/redesign-execution-contract-owner-decisions-references-and-proof-f8007f2ae99c>), [45-finding audit](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/audit-evidence-45-og-ux-findings-2026-09-21-9137eb58e042>) and [fast writing specification](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/fast-writing-spaces-objects-destination-picker-and-recovery-4a839349a952>).

## Scope (in / out)

In: all numbered criteria and their integration/proof, including responsive, role, locale and failure states. This issue intentionally consolidates related original work packages 33 after the owner chose 32 executable issues to fit Linear's workspace limit; none of those acceptance requirements is deferred. Out: unrelated backend/persistence/security changes, duplicate static/performance/editorial implementations or unapproved destructive production operations. Public static bytes, canonical addresses, server authorization, settled workspace reads, Lexical/JournalDocumentV1 and browser WebP publishing remain authoritative. No durable gardener drafts; owner editorial drafts remain a separate allowed contract.

## Key files

* `apps/web/src/components/public/public-community.tsx`
* `apps/web/src/app/[locale]/communities/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/account/communities/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/account/moderation/comments/`
* `docs/redesign/2026-09-21/EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md`, current `AGENTS.md` and relevant ADRs.

These are baseline entry points, not a file whitelist. Resolve moved paths and explicitly document new routes/components. Do not restore retired surfaces merely because an old path appears here.

## Acceptance criteria

 1. Directory cards and detail header explain topic, community identity and actual supported membership/contribution actions. Use [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) topic attribution/navigation mechanism while retaining Threads styling.
 2. Community Write carries exact community context through sign-in and supported contribution composer; do not silently turn a discussion into an owned-object entry. If entries can be shared, preserve one original identity and existing association rules.
 3. Show current discussion list, author/date, relevant community information and clear empty-first-contribution state. Right rail supports this community rather than generic welcome content.
 4. Discussion detail reuses readable post/comment controls while respecting its own entity and canonical URL. No unsupported ranking or moderation capability invented.
 5. Move community management to appropriate owner/account context with role checks and purposeful settings; no admin panel recreation.
 6. Verify back navigation, guest entry points, deleted discussions, forbidden contribution and partial errors.
 7. Show content context, author, reason/state and actual available action before changing moderation state; avoid unlabeled icon-only destructive actions.
 8. Separate queue filtering, item review and community settings into meaningful sections. Preserve exact comment/discussion/community identity when moving between them.
 9. Confirm destructive consequences where required, keep cancel and retry safe, prevent double submission and reconcile actual server result.
10. Guest/ordinary member cannot read protected content or perform owner mutations even when copying a URL or submitting a forged form.
11. Provide empty queue, loading, failed row and failed list states; preserve filter/scroll on action and do not hide unrelated rows after one error.
12. Use Phosphor, semantic tables/lists, accessible menus and responsive controls; reuse community public context without exposing private moderation metadata.

## Proof

Guest→sign-in→same community intent, member post in seeded environment, comments and directory/detail/back across locales. Assert submitted community ID and absence of accidental garden-object creation.

Controlled owner review, failed action, duplicate submit and ordinary-member forged request tests; keyboard and mobile populated queues with exact server-state readback.

Attach exact tested SHA, behavior/file summary, screenshots and relevant gate output. Verify applicable guest/member/owner roles, UK/BG/RU long labels, narrow/wide layouts, keyboard, zoom, empty/populated and pending/error/retry states. Public changes require canonical/static/no-JS proof; workspace changes require hard-load failure proof. Mutations require acknowledged server outcomes. Register browser specs in the actual gate; automated accessibility checks do not replace manual evidence. Follow repository PR/CI/release rules, distinguishing local results from production; production test mutations require applicable authorization.

readbacks.title: Redesign consent, privacy and member/owner erasure workflows
readbacks.description:
## Outcome

Trust surfaces communicate real choices and consequences while keeping public reading accessible. The owner can understand and process erasure requests with accurate consequences and clear state while existing deletion policy remains authoritative.

Audit traceability: OG-UX-004, OG-UX-037, OG-UX-044. Baseline: 2026-09-21, e554aec506e84ec6f8304c4704084671ed19f399. Recheck current main before editing.

## Owner decisions this task implements

Radical layout/IA/page regrouping is authorized. Threads leads the light visual system; [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) provides the centered three-column group and relevant reading/social patterns; Airbnb informs progressive setup. Phosphor is the sole UI icon library. Thiings selection/use is unrestricted by owner direction, with no purchase or license-review gate; provider facts are recorded honestly in the contract. The central goal is quick acknowledged writing to any owned space/object, including large collections.

References: [Airbnb web progressive search](<https://mobbin.com/flows/4e9f5861-5367-4700-883b-248771553904>); [Airbnb mobile progressive search](<https://mobbin.com/flows/0fb29365-f327-46b6-9a6d-2dfbb5589716>). Read the [execution contract](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/redesign-execution-contract-owner-decisions-references-and-proof-f8007f2ae99c>), [45-finding audit](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/audit-evidence-45-og-ux-findings-2026-09-21-9137eb58e042>) and [fast writing specification](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/fast-writing-spaces-objects-destination-picker-and-recovery-4a839349a952>).

## Scope (in / out)

In: all numbered criteria and their integration/proof, including responsive, role, locale and failure states. This issue intentionally consolidates related original work packages 35 after the owner chose 32 executable issues to fit Linear's workspace limit; none of those acceptance requirements is deferred. Out: unrelated backend/persistence/security changes, duplicate static/performance/editorial implementations or unapproved destructive production operations. Public static bytes, canonical addresses, server authorization, settled workspace reads, Lexical/JournalDocumentV1 and browser WebP publishing remain authoritative. No durable gardener drafts; owner editorial drafts remain a separate allowed contract.

## Key files

* `apps/web/src/lib/privacy/`
* `apps/web/src/app/[locale]/privacy/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/first-publication-disclosure/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/erasure/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/support/`
* `apps/web/src/app/(default)/garden/privacy/erasure-requests/`
* `docs/redesign/2026-09-21/EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md`, current `AGENTS.md` and relevant ADRs.

These are baseline entry points, not a file whitelist. Resolve moved paths and explicitly document new routes/components. Do not restore retired surfaces merely because an old path appears here.

## Acceptance criteria

 1. Reduce consent obstruction using an accessible responsive placement. Preserve the existing requirement that undecided visitors see the notice on every page until a choice; no silent acceptance or hidden rejection.
 2. Choice controls remain equally understandable, keyboard reachable and usable at 320px/zoom. The overlay must not cover focused primary content indefinitely; test mobile safe areas.
 3. Privacy/disclosure/support follow reader-oriented typography and corrected factual content from task 02. Link to detailed explanations instead of showing database/queue jargon in the main flow.
 4. Erasure request describes scope, current retention and actual receipt/status; distinguish deleting an entry from erasing account-associated data and external cached copies.
 5. Keep token/verification failure, pending, accepted and completed states honest. Do not implement a destructive schema or bulk purge under UX authorization.
 6. Preserve consent-based analytics exclusions and first-publication acceptance logic.
 7. List requests with appropriate minimal identity, received date, verification state and next permissible action; keep sensitive details limited to needed role-protected views.
 8. Explain queue/processing/completed/failed state in plain language. Technical references may be available as secondary diagnostics rather than primary instructions.
 9. Destructive confirmation must describe actual scope; never implement bulk purge or destructive schema changes under redesign authorization.
10. Retry follows existing idempotent lifecycle and does not manufacture completion. Preserve audit receipts and retention behavior.
11. Cover empty/populated/error states, keyboard action flow, mobile tables and owner-role rejection for ordinary members.

## Proof

Undecided/accepted/rejected consent on multiple public routes, mobile zoom, keyboard and no-JS behavior; seeded erasure/support states and a content-to-contract reconciliation.

Seed lifecycle fixtures and demonstrate safe cancel/failed retry/read-only state transitions. Use approved controlled environment for mutation proof; report production approval requirements separately.

Attach exact tested SHA, behavior/file summary, screenshots and relevant gate output. Verify applicable guest/member/owner roles, UK/BG/RU long labels, narrow/wide layouts, keyboard, zoom, empty/populated and pending/error/retry states. Public changes require canonical/static/no-JS proof; workspace changes require hard-load failure proof. Mutations require acknowledged server outcomes. Register browser specs in the actual gate; automated accessibility checks do not replace manual evidence. Follow repository PR/CI/release rules, distinguishing local results from production; production test mutations require applicable authorization.

readbacks.title: Complete product redesign — audit implementation and release coordination
readbacks.description:
## Outcome

Coordinate the complete OverGarden redesign authorized on 2026-09-21. This issue is a coordination container, not an executable coding task or branch. Its 32 implementation children deliver the new information architecture, all current product surfaces and verified release.

## Owner decisions this task implements

Radical reorganization is authorized. Threads is the primary style; [vc.ru](<http://vc.ru>) supplies centered three columns and relevant content interactions; Airbnb supplies progressive creation. All UI icons use Phosphor. Thiings illustration selection is unrestricted by owner direction, free use with no purchase or license-review gate; factual provider terms are separately recorded without inventing a license. Writing quickly to any owned space/object, including large collections, is the central success criterion.

## Scope (in / out)

In: the complete current public/member/owner UI, structure and flows, audit closure and integration. Out: duplicating existing static-document/performance/editorial backend tasks, changing unrelated journal/public/security/data contracts, production destructive operations under UI authorization. No subagents were used for planning.

Authoritative [execution contract](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/redesign-execution-contract-owner-decisions-references-and-proof-f8007f2ae99c>), [45-finding audit](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/audit-evidence-45-og-ux-findings-2026-09-21-9137eb58e042>) and [fast-writing specification](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/fast-writing-spaces-objects-destination-picker-and-recovery-4a839349a952>). Local package: docs/redesign/2026-09-21/ and docs/audits/2026-09-21-product-design/.

## Key files

* DESIGN.md and docs/PROJECT_STATE.md
* docs/adr/ADR-0031-design-system-and-redesign.md and current product ADRs
* docs/redesign/2026-09-21/ (issue manifest, route/finding ownership and execution order)
* docs/audits/2026-09-21-product-design/ (historical evidence)

## Acceptance criteria

1. All 32 children exist with the required seven sections, concrete behavior criteria, evidence requirements and native blocking relationships.
2. Every OG-UX-001 through OG-UX-045 has an implementation owner and eventual receipt; route inventory has no unowned current family.
3. New direction is explicit in the canon; previous Done redesign tasks are not reopened or accepted as new proof.
4. Existing <issue id="faf54cbd-0537-46eb-b6e7-6eb89052ba84" href="https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-467/the-remaining-public-families-become-static-documents-adr-0032-d8">OVE-467</issue>/468/469 are consumed as external dependencies. Planned editorial work retains original ownership and consumes new design contracts without duplicate implementation.
5. All required implementation and final integration receipts pass before this container becomes Done. Missing proof is not silently waived.

## Proof

[Verified execution queue, finding map and route ownership](<https://linear.app/overgarden/document/execution-queue-32-issues-45-findings-and-114-route-owners-4497b79896cd>). Includes all 32 executable issues in topological order, 45 audit owners and 114 baseline source page owners.

Consolidation approved by the owner after the workspace issue limit was reached: icon migration is part of design foundations; moderation is part of community delivery; lineage inboxes/handoffs are part of object passports; owner erasure is part of privacy; final cross-product localization, accessibility and release are one integration issue (<issue id="24829486-4068-4112-8277-2dd120c6de89" href="https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-478/integrate-verify-and-release-the-complete-product-redesign">OVE-478</issue>). All original work-package criteria are retained. Native dependencies were rebuilt to avoid the integration task blocking its own prerequisites.

During planning: authenticated readback of task bodies, parent/project membership, status and dependency DAG plus saved manifest. At delivery: final integration child supplies exact release SHA, CI, deployment/public rendering/performance and authenticated journey proof; attach its closure ledger here.

## Dependencies

Execute children in the verified dependency order; issue numbers are not execution order. The final release child blocks completion of this container; the container must never block its own children. Existing technical work <issue id="faf54cbd-0537-46eb-b6e7-6eb89052ba84" href="https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-467/the-remaining-public-families-become-static-documents-adr-0032-d8">OVE-467</issue>/468/469 is reused without changing its status or scope. Coordinate shared shell files with [OVE-468](<https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-468/a-guest-on-a-reading-page-downloads-337-kb-of-script-the-chromes>), and future editorial components with <issue id="d7c6c66e-0630-4f8b-8b19-455885269a34" href="https://linear.app/overgarden/issue/OVE-406/the-agent-block-on-the-news-and-blog-pages-the-instruction-the-owner">OVE-406</issue>.
